description: This file defines a TraceLoader class responsible for loading and processing trace data, including reading trace files, managing resources, and handling trace actions and metadata within a testing or tracing framework.

classes.name: TraceLoader
classes.description: A class for loading and processing trace data, managing context entries, resources, and trace actions.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads trace data from a backend, processes trace files, and updates context entries.

methods.name: hasEntry
methods.description: Checks if a specific trace entry exists in the backend.

methods.name: resourceForSha1
methods.description: Retrieves a resource blob by its SHA-1 hash, returning a Blob with appropriate content type.

methods.name: storage
methods.description: Returns the SnapshotStorage instance used by the loader.
